fnf-starcatcher.title: FNF StarCatcher - Free Online Rhythm Game
fnf-starcatcher.slogan: Catch the Beat, Catch the Stars!
fnf-starcatcher.description: Engage in fast-paced music battles in FNF StarCatcher and test your talented timing skills! The galactic setting and catchy tunes keep you on your toes! Are you ready for the ultimate rhythm game experience with FNF StarCatcher? The gripping mod of the Friday Night Funkin' series is about to take the gaming world by storm! In this rhythm game, you will embark on a musical journey unlike any other. This addictive rhythm game combines the best of both worlds: the vibrant rhythms of Friday Night Funkin' and the celestial magic of the starry night sky. With mesmerizing visuals and a captivating soundtrack, you will be hooked from the very first note. So, what are you waiting for? Get on the beat and join the StarCatcher revolution!
